import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitizes and formats a blog entry for web display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on the webpage. Notes ----- - Uses `html.escape` to neutralize potentially dangerous characters, protecting against XSS and other injection attacks. - No external libraries are required beyond the standard library. """ # Sanitize headline and content to prevent HTML injection safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Insert the sanitized values into the HTML template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
